payout_quote: The Truity Member will earn a Visa Virtual Reward for each friend or family member they refer to Truity Credit Union who registers, opens a new eligible account, and completes the offer requirements within the specified time.
steps: Be a Truity Credit Union member and register for the referral program on the Truity website.
Invite friends/family by email or social media with your referral link; they must register for the program and open a new eligible account.
Checking referrals: your friend opens a new Truity personal checking account and sets up direct deposit within 60 days of account opening - you earn a $50 Visa Virtual Reward.
Auto loan referrals: your friend closes a new direct auto loan and signs up for automatic transfers within 60 days - you earn $50.
Personal loan referrals: your friend closes a new personal loan of $5,000+ and signs up for automatic transfers within 60 days - you earn $50.
Credit card referrals: your friend opens a new Truity credit card and spends $3,000+ in purchases within 90 days - you earn $50.
Your Visa Virtual Reward Card is emailed to you within 2-3 weeks after all requirements are verified (checking referrals may take longer while direct deposits are confirmed).
catches: The $50 is a Visa Virtual Reward Card (email-delivered virtual card), not cash - and it is valid for only 3 months from issuance, usable anywhere Visa debit is accepted.
Both the member and the friend must be registered for the program at the time of account opening.
Friend-side requirements are strict: checking needs direct deposit within 60 days; credit card needs $3,000 in purchases within 90 days.
Combined virtual gift cards of $600 or more in a calendar year may be reported on IRS form 1099-INT.
Only one Truity Member earns the reward per referred friend.
Program and incentives may be subject to change; cannot be combined with other offers.
biggest_catch: The $50 arrives as a virtual Visa card that expires in 3 months - and your friend has to complete real requirements like direct deposit or $3,000 in card spending before either of you earns anything.
eligibility: Must be a Truity Credit Union member to start referring. Referred friends must be new eligible-account holders; both participants registered at account opening.
timing: Reward delivered via email 2-3 weeks after all requirements are completed and verified.

c1.evidence: Truity Credit Union - real federally-insured credit union (NCUA); official domain truitycu.org, Refer a Friend terms fetched 2026-09-23.

c2.evidence: Official terms state the Truity Member earns 'a Visa Virtual Reward for each friend or family member they refer' - $50 per referral for checking, auto loan, personal loan, and credit card referrals; friend-side also gets paid.

c3.evidence: No fee to refer; registering and sharing a link/email; no purchase or spending required of the referrer.

c4.evidence: Official terms: reward emailed within 2-3 weeks after verification; no cap stated ('the more friends you refer, the more you can earn'); concrete friend qualification requirements per product.

s1.note: Must be a Truity CU member; friend must be a new eligible-account holder.

s2.note: Friend registers via link, opens eligible product, completes requirement (checking: direct deposit 60 days; auto/personal loan: auto transfers 60 days; card: $3,000/90 days).

s3.note: Visa Virtual Reward emailed within 2-3 weeks after completion and verification.

s4.note: Flat $50 per referral for all four product types; friend-side $250 (checking) or $50 (others).
